items.body:
Thanks for the detailed analysis. To investigate this, we need a minimal runnable example that reproduces the hang without Harbor, LiteLLM or aiohttp, for example a few threads or asyncio tasks that print or log while a `Live` with `redirect_stdout=True` and `auto_refresh=True` is running. Please also include the output of `python -m rich.diagnose`, since you mention Rich 14.2.0 and Linux but not the exact terminal. Related earlier reports: #927 (deadlock when exiting `Status`) and #3125 (redirected output with `Live`).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
